test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A can complete a work in 8 days and B can complete the same work in 11 days. How long will they take, if both work together?
solution:
Given:

A can complete work = 8 days

B can complete work = 11 days

Formula Used:

Total Work = Total time taken x Efficiency

Calculation:

A can complete work = 8 days

B can complete work = 11 days

For total work, we have to take LCM of 8 and 11

⇒ LCM of 8 and 11 = 88

So, The efficiency of A = Total work / time taken

⇒ 88 / 8 = 11 unit

The efficiency of B = Total work / time taken 

⇒ 88 / 11 = 8 unit

They together can complete the work in

Efficiency of A and B together = Efficiency of A + Efficiency of B 

⇒ 11 + 8 = 19 unit/day

Time taken = Total work / Efficiency of both 

⇒ 88 / 19 = 4(12)/(19) days

**Hence, The time taken by both to complete the work is 4(12)/(19) days.**
